description: Wai draws an indicative site layout from a plain request and returns its key numbers, a quantities table, screening checks and a link to view the plan (2D, 3D, facades). Understands: solar PV farm (MWp or ha), substation (kV, MVA), data center campus (MW IT), overhead transmission line (kV, km), underground cable, gas/water pipeline (km, DN), wind / BESS / hybrid plant, green hydrogen plant (electrolyser MW), thermal / combined-cycle plant. Returns an electrical & mechanical bill of quantities (each row with how it was counted), example products from the makers, a recommended ground investigation (boreholes, pile tests, resistivity, Vs30; with lat / lng also a SoilGrids ground screening), official market figures when a country is named, and a PDF report link. Example: "154/33 kV substation 2x50 MVA", "20 MW solar farm with trackers". DWG / DXF / IFC / Revit files are downloaded in Wai. Use this tool whenever the user asks to make / design / lay out a plant or project, and show the returned plan as the project's technical design (not images of other projects from the web). Answer with the returned numbers, not an estimate made before the call.

lat.description: optional site latitude: adds a ground screening (ISRIC SoilGrids)
